<!-- pr-reviewer: 2756f724ddc5ebe20cda148f189da905ca8345b1 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The diff is 135 files under `crates/app/tests` plus `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`, `docs/decisions/922-gate-maps.md`, `xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs` and a 2-line `mod gate_maps_tests;` in `xtask/src/main.rs`. In the test files every added or removed line is a `//` or `//!` comment. No test code changed.
- I parsed all 680 `crate::module` names in the changed Gate map headers against the crates' src trees. All but three resolve to a real top-level module. The other three are valid submodule paths: `geometry::slice` (`geometry/geometry/mod.rs:18`), `post::dump` and `cl::frame` (`cl/cl/mod.rs:28`). Nothing is stale.
- No build.rs, `.github/`, scripts or dependency changes. No snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit. Body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #922`. The conventional subject is fine and the new module has a provenance line.
- The `PROCESS_VERSION` bump is correct. `upstream/main` is 16, the PR is 17, and `xtask/` is a process file. #930 also bumping to 16 is fine; whichever merges second renumbers.

**Local results, merged with current upstream/main (already up to date; no conflicts; GitHub says MERGEABLE)**
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 37 passed, 0 failed (includes the 5 new `gate_maps_tests`).
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- I did not run the app suites: only comments changed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run`, one-line probe change per file. This is the "suites selected by gate map" figure, before (main's headers) and after (this PR):

| Changed file | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` (`post::post`) | 7 | 37 |
| `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs` (submodule) | 3 | 10 |
| `crates/sim/src/verify/mod.rs` (`sim::verify`) | 28 | 60 |
| `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` (`motion::machining2d`) | 38 | 67 |

The after-plans list the intended `app:*` suites, for example `app:carvera_post - gate map names post::post`. The PR body's app-only counts (3 to 33 and so on) are the same effect counted differently.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- When this merges, add the #681 comment `PROCESS_VERSION 17`. A fork needs nothing beyond the normal process sync.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
